emails.subject: Semester 5 fee payment — last date 05 Dec 2026
emails.body:
Dear Harinadh (1EP25CS121),

This is a reminder that the Semester 5 tuition fee of ₹48,500 is due. The last date for payment is 05 December 2026. A late fee of ₹500 per week will apply after that.

Pay through the student portal: Fees → Semester 5 → Pay now. Keep the receipt for your records.

For fee-related queries, contact the Accounts Office between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM.

Accounts Office
East Point College of Engineering

emails.subject: Semester 5 exam registration — closes 10 Dec 2026
emails.body:
All Semester 5 students must register for the end-semester examinations. The registration window closes on 10 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.

Exam fee: ₹750 (pay online and attach the receipt). Registration after the deadline needs the HOD's approval and a ₹300 late fee.

Hall tickets will be released only to students who complete registration. Use the Examinations section of the student portal.

Controller of Examinations

emails.subject: Schmidt Futures scholarship — apply by 15 Dec 2026
emails.body:
Applications are open for the Schmidt Futures scholarship for the 2026–27 academic year. Eligibility: CGPA 8.0 or above and household income below ₹8 lakh per year.

Submit a 500-word essay and income certificate. The application closes on 15 December 2026. Shortlisted students will be interviewed in January.

Apply through the Scholarship Cell portal and keep a copy of your submission.

Scholarship Cell

emails.subject: wHACKiest 2026 — reporting time and venue
emails.body:
Hi Team Codex,

wHACKiest 2026 runs on 26–27 November 2026 at the Main Auditorium, East Point College. Reporting time on 26 November is 8:30 AM sharp.

Carry your college ID and extension cords. Track 1 is Make MCP Matter (Spark). Judging starts at 4:00 PM on 27 November.

Regards,
Organising Team

emails.subject: Hostel mess fee — December 2026
emails.body:
The mess fee for December 2026 is ₹3,200. The last date to pay is 30 November 2026. Payments after the due date will attract a ₹200 fine and may affect mess access.

Pay at the hostel office or through the portal (Hostel → Mess → December).

Hostel Office

emails.subject: Overdue library books — return by 28 Nov 2026
emails.body:
Two books issued to you are due: "Introduction to Algorithms" and "Database System Concepts". Please return them by 28 November 2026 to avoid a fine of ₹5 per book per day.

Renew online if you still need them (Library → My books → Renew).

Central Library

emails.subject: Infosys interview slot — 27 Nov 2026, 10:00 AM
emails.body:
Your Infosys interview is confirmed for 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM IST. Join the virtual room 10 minutes early with your resume and college ID.

The interview runs for about 45 minutes. If you need to reschedule, tell the Placement Cell at least 24 hours in advance.

Placement Cell

emails.subject: TCS NQT registration — last date 12 Dec 2026
emails.body:
Registrations for the TCS National Qualifier Test are open. The last date to register is 12 December 2026. The test window is 20–22 December 2026.

Registration fee: ₹300. Create your NQT profile, upload your resume, and choose the Bangalore centre.

Placement Cell
